name: thesis-2
text: The first professional question is measurement integrity—not prediction.
textPreview: The first professional question is measurement integrity—not prediction.

text:
DECISION D40 — FORWARD-RISK MEASUREMENT, NOT SENTIMENT

Question
What is the minimal professional interpretation of an ATM straddle before outcome analysis?

Decision
Treat the normalized call-plus-put price as an asset-specific forward-risk measurement. Do not label it sentiment or directional conviction.

Why
Option prices jointly reflect expected variability, jump/event risk, risk premia, supply and demand, and microstructure. A useful measurement need not identify each component, but its interpretation must remain narrower than its data.

DECISION D40 — FROZEN O0 CONTRACT

Scope
SPY, QQQ, and IWM. After-close 17:30 ET authority. Expiry nearest 30 calendar days inside 21–45 DTE. Strike nearest raw underlying 15:45 ET VWAP. Both option legs must share strike, expiry, and timestamp. The feature is normalized to 30 days.

Promotion
At least 90% matched-pair coverage for every ETF plus timestamp, feed, provenance, and leakage integrity.

Prohibited rescues
No missing-leg interpolation, one-sided substitution, timestamp mixing, DTE-window loosening, outcome join, or model.

DECISION D41 — ACCOUNT CAPABILITY NARROWS O0

Evidence
Paper-host contract retrieval passed; 5,456 immutable active definitions were admitted. The feed-selectable snapshot probe returned HTTP 403 for OPRA and HTTP 200 for indicative. Historical bars use the account-default feed because that endpoint currently rejects a feed query parameter.

History limitation
The paper contract endpoint returned no expired contracts for the probe date. O0 was therefore frozen to July 20–24, 2026, when the selected August 21 expiries remained active at retrieval. This avoids fabricating or applying current mutable metadata historically.

Meaning
This is a retail-accessible indicative-feed plumbing proof, not OPRA-quality or February-2024 backfill evidence.

DECISION D42 — STOP O0 RECONSTRUCTION

Coverage
SPY passed at 5/5. QQQ stopped at 4/5 because its July 22 call had no 15:45 bar. IWM stopped at 3/5 because the July 23 put and July 24 call had no 15:45 bar.

Diagnosis
Underlying final bars were complete at 15/15 and same-strike same-expiry definitions were complete at 15/15. The failure is option-leg bar sparsity on the indicative feed at the frozen timestamp.

Gate logic
The contract required at least 90% for every ETF. QQQ at 80% and IWM at 60% cannot be averaged away by SPY's 100%.

Observation
Where both indicative legs exist, the normalized measure is numerically coherent: SPY is complete, QQQ has one gap, and IWM has two gaps.

A visually smooth or economically plausible subset does not make missing decision rows safe. Any fill rule would become a new representation choice requiring its own frozen justification and confirmation data.

Boundary
No future realized volatility, return direction, VIX control, model, or PnL appears on these tapes.

DECISION D42 — O1 REMAINS CLOSED

Decision
Record STOP_O0_RECONSTRUCTION. Do not test the implied-move proxy against future volatility on this five-session, incomplete indicative surface.

What the POC accomplished
It proved contract access, feed entitlement, raw-underlying alignment, same-strike same-expiry selection, formula construction, and auditable missing-leg detection. It also falsified the assumption that the current retail feed can supply the frozen final-bar measure reliably across all three ETFs.

Possible future reopeners
A defensible expired-contract catalog, OPRA access or another suitably dense equivalent feed, or a separate theory-first contract for a different pricing timestamp/missing-data representation. Each would be a new gate, not a rescue on these inspected rows.
